title: Moisture Dynamics with Phase Changes in a Compressible Hydrostatic Atmosphere
summary: In this article, a rigorous well-posedness result is established for a moist compressible primitive-equation system with phase changes. The model couples the compressible primitive equations to a bulk microphysics model for vapor water, cloud water, and rain water, including evaporation, condensation, auto-conversion, collection, and sedimentation effects. Global strong well-posedness is proved for initial data sufficiently close to constant equilibria.
